description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Siyambalanduwa, Siyambalanduwa D/S Division, Monaragala District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including their ownership status, extent, and legal classifications. The content focuses entirely on land property matters, cadastral maps, and title settlements, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
